prompt:
Task / size class:
BWJ-1 / Loop 096 — MEDIUM, pure wake identity + GitHub PR event classifier.

Goal:
Implement the smallest pure helper that decides whether one GitHub pull_request event represents a J-BLUE Jules result that should wake the Blue Cloud Work controller. This stage performs no GitHub write, no Work wake, no Jules dispatch, no network call, and no webhook server. It only normalizes a fixture/event plus explicit lineage inputs into IGNORE / WAKE / UNKNOWN and one deterministic logical Blue command identity.

Read first:
- docs/BLUE_WORK_JULES_WEBHOOK_LOOP_ROADMAP.md (BWJ-1 only; do not implement BWJ-2+)
- automation/command_bus/event_processor.py
- automation/command_bus/reviewer_wake_backend.py
- automation/command_bus/jules_publication.py
- automation/command_bus/jules_api_request.py
- automation/command_bus/validation_scope.py
- automation/command_bus/tests/test_jules_publication.py
- automation/command_bus/tests/test_reviewer_wake_backend.py

Allowed changed paths only:
- automation/command_bus/blue_jules_result_event.py
- automation/command_bus/tests/test_blue_jules_result_event.py

Hard scope / Do Not Touch:
- add/modify only the two allowed files
- no workflow, schema, docs, carrier, claim, ledger, dependency, lockfile, or configuration change
- no GitHub API/client call and no filesystem/network side effect in the helper
- no GitHub write
- no Cloud Work command/review submission
- no worker generation mutation
- no Jules API/session/provider/model invocation
- no webhook server/listener
- no polling/scheduler/queue/database/framework
- no Merge, rebase, force push, branch delete, default-branch write, settings/permissions/billing/secrets changes
- retry=0; fallback=disabled
- do not implement BWJ-2 or later stages

Existing implementation to reuse:
- Reuse the repository's existing fail-closed dataclass/StrEnum style where useful.
- Reuse the existing static command-bus validation conventions and SHA/identity validation idioms where semantically compatible.
- Reuse small existing primitives/idioms rather than designing a generic event framework.
- Do not duplicate broad command-bus machinery or invent a second dispatcher.
- If an existing helper already directly satisfies one requirement, call/reuse it instead of cloning its logic.

Required semantics:
1. Provide one importable pure classifier for a GitHub pull_request event plus explicit lineage inputs; exact API naming is local to the new module but must be simple and directly testable.
2. The decision state vocabulary is exactly IGNORE, WAKE, UNKNOWN.
3. Accepted GitHub event actions are exactly opened and synchronize. Other well-formed actions are IGNORE.
4. Expected repository is kamiyusense/multi-ai-council-phase0. A clearly different repository is IGNORE.
5. Extract and validate PR number as positive integer, current result HEAD as exact lowercase 40-hex SHA, and PR base ref/base SHA needed for lineage.
6. Explicit lineage input must bind at least:
   - source Jules command_id
   - isolated Jules work_branch
   - expected_target_head
   - expected repository
7. A result is eligible only when the event PR base ref equals the expected isolated work_branch and the event base SHA equals expected_target_head. A clearly unrelated base branch is IGNORE. Missing/malformed required identity is UNKNOWN. A candidate whose work_branch matches but whose base SHA does not match expected_target_head is UNKNOWN (fail closed), not WAKE.
8. Do not use actor/display color/PR title as correctness evidence.
9. Derive deterministic logical Blue command identity exactly as:
   blue-jules-result-pr<PR_NUMBER>-<FULL_HEAD_SHA>
   using the full lowercase 40-hex current result head.
10. Same PR + same HEAD must always produce the same logical identity.
11. Accept an explicit collection/set of already-seen logical Blue command IDs (pure input only). If the derived identity already exists, return IGNORE while preserving/reporting the same deterministic identity so semantic duplicate delivery is a NO-OP.
12. A new HEAD for the same PR produces a distinct deterministic identity and may WAKE if all other gates match.
13. Wrong repository, unrelated human PR/base, or unsupported action must be cheaply classifiable as IGNORE without requiring fabricated missing lineage/event details.
14. Missing/malformed event envelope, PR number, head, relevant base SHA/ref, or lineage fields returns UNKNOWN; do not throw for ordinary malformed/untrusted fixture input.
15. The helper performs no mutation and no I/O.
16. Keep the implementation narrowly specific to BWJ-1; no generic plugin/orchestration abstraction.

Negative / tamper / failure cases:
- matching Jules result PR opened -> WAKE
- matching Jules result PR synchronize -> WAKE
- same PR + same HEAD -> identical command_id
- duplicate same derived command_id in already-seen set -> IGNORE / same identity
- same PR + new valid HEAD -> new command_id and WAKE
- unrelated human PR/base -> IGNORE
- wrong repository -> IGNORE
- unsupported action -> IGNORE
- missing head -> UNKNOWN
- uppercase, short, non-hex or otherwise malformed head -> UNKNOWN
- missing/malformed PR number -> UNKNOWN
- missing/malformed lineage -> UNKNOWN
- expected work_branch match but base SHA lineage mismatch -> UNKNOWN
- missing base ref/base SHA on an otherwise candidate event -> UNKNOWN
- actor/title/color changes cannot turn an unrelated event into WAKE
- malformed top-level payload -> UNKNOWN
- no vacuous assertions; tests must exercise returned state, identity and reason/boundary directly

Acceptance criteria:
- exact two-file allowed-path fence
- pure deterministic helper; no network/GitHub client/filesystem/write side effects
- direct tests cover every minimum fixture from BWJ-1 roadmap and all negative cases above
- state vocabulary limited to IGNORE/WAKE/UNKNOWN
- deterministic identity uses full head SHA exactly
- no BWJ-2 prepare/post logic
- no workflow/schema/dependency changes
- full command-bus unittest suite passes
- compileall passes
- git diff --check passes

Exact validation commands:
python -m unittest automation.command_bus.tests.test_blue_jules_result_event -v
python -m unittest discover -s automation/command_bus/tests -v
python -m compileall -q automation/command_bus
git diff --check

Publication condition:
Only if the exact allowed-path fence holds and all required validation commands pass, create the normal Jules result PR from the isolated work branch descendant. Do not Merge.

Explicit stop conditions:
- correct implementation would require any path outside the two allowed files
- correct implementation requires GitHub/network/live Work/Jules/provider/model execution
- BWJ-2+ functionality is required
- repository/lineage semantics cannot be established from the listed current docs/helpers without inventing a new protocol
- any required safety rule would need weakening
